---
title: "Help! 😱"
---

Stuck? Start here — before or during the course. This page exists so that in class, the answer can be "have a look at Help → \[topic\]" instead of re-explaining the same beginner snag five times a day.

Pick what's happening:

- 🔍 **[R cannot find my file](file-not-found.qmd)** — `Error: 'data/x.csv' does not exist` and friends.
- 📦 **[A package won't install](package-wont-install.qmd)** — `install.packages()` fails, or `library()` says it's not there.
- ❓ **[Object not found](object-not-found.qmd)** — `Error: object 'x' not found`.
- 🧩 **[My code just doesn't run](code-wont-run.qmd)** — nothing happens, or the console shows a `+` and won't stop.

Not seeing your problem? That's expected — this page grows as real questions come up. If you're a student hitting this during the live course, just ask; if you're Tahereh or Genona adding to this page later, the pattern for each entry is: **what you see → what it means → the fix**, kept to a few lines each.
